'''Zone Zero''' was an area of [[Transport Station 5]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] that was infested with [[rakghoul]]s during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]]. When the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] first began to resettle Taris, they sent a team of surveyors into the area, but only one returned. Zone Zero was the location of a secret vault holding an [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]] chart owned by the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Nok Drayen]]. During the [[invasion of Taris]], [[Jicoln Cadera]] kept a camp there.
